comments.author: RaiRaiTheRaichu Staff
comments.body_html:
Before commenting, please make sure you have checked out the Compatibility and Known Issues section of the mod page.

TL;DR:

- No realism patch included. If you make one, please send it to me so I can add it!

- Conflicts with MightyCondor’s Desert Eagle and M60 backports.

If there are any major issues, please let me know, but I’m not likely going to put much more work into this, if any. After all, SPT 3.10.0 is getting closer and closer.

EDIT: I’ve been getting a lot of weird questions about this mod being “incompatible” with other weapon mods, or people assuming it’s not. Just for clarification, this mod will work with any weapon mod. The new attachments may or may not fit on custom weapons, depending on how the weapon is implemented. That’s about it.

“When update”

I may not have the time to backport the rest of the stuff to 3.9.x. Since SPT 3.10.x is here, a lot of my focus has shifted on that. The only things missing from this are the AA12 and a few attachments, so it’s not particularly much.
